regions.today: Mainly dry for most this evening with generally cloudy skies. An isolated patch of rain is possible, mainly along eastern coasts. All in light easterly or variable winds.
regions.tonight: Largely dry tonight with plenty of clear spells and some cloud. There will be light easterly winds, though sometimes variable at times. Feeling cold overnight with lows of 0 to 5 degrees, coldest in the north, leading to frost patches here. Some mist and fog may develop too, mainly in western parts.
regions.tomorrow: Another cold start with any patchy mist and fog clearing. There will be a mixture of bright or sunny spells and partly cloudy skies, though cloud will increase throughout the day. Generally dry all day, though an isolated shower is possible near coasts. All in light south-easterly winds, increasing moderate and gusty during the evening hours. Highs of 10 to 12 degrees.
